'''Mahindra World City, Jaipur''' is a multi-product [[Special Economic Zone]] based on the concept of an "Integrated Business City". It comprises SEZs, Industrial Parks, and Retail and Social Infrastructure.<ref>{{cite web|title=Pink Mahindra City|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/features/weekend-life/pink-mahindra-city/article5422088.ece|publisher=The Hindu Business Line|accessdate=9 July 2014}}</ref>

==History==
In 2007, Mahindra World City, [[Jaipur]] was inaugurated by former Chief Minister of Rajasthan, [[Vasundhara Raje]]. It is a joint undertaking by [[Mahindra Lifespace Developers]] Ltd (a [[Mahindra Group]] Company) and [[Rajasthan State Industrial Development and Investment Corporation]] Ltd (RIICO), an agency of the [[Government of Rajasthan]]. It has been identified as one of the 16 projects globally by the [[Clinton Foundation|Clinton Climate Initiative]] (CCI),<ref>{{cite web|title=Clinton Climate Initiative To Demonstrate Model For Sustainable Urban Growth With Projects In 10 Countries On Six Continents|url=http://www.clintonfoundation.org/main/news-and-media/press-releases-and-statements/press-release-clinton-climate-initiative-to-demostrate-model-for-sustainable-urb.html|publisher=Clinton Foundation|accessdate=9 July 2014}}</ref> a foundation upheld by Former US President [[Bill Clinton]] with a focus on [[sustainable development]]. 2017

==Location==
Mahindra World City is built near NH8 (Jaipur–Ajmer highway), and spread over an area of 3000 acres.<ref>{{cite news|title=M&M to set up SEZ at Jaipur|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2005-10-06/news/27494430_1_mahindra-world-city-m-m-vice-chairman-jaipur-project|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140716184501/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2005-10-06/news/27494430_1_mahindra-world-city-m-m-vice-chairman-jaipur-project|url-status=dead|archive-date=16 July 2014|accessdate=9 July 2014|work=Economic Times|date=6 October 2005}}</ref> Mahindra World City is located near Jaipur City, 18 km from the airport and 21 km from the railway station. Apart from Jaipur, Mahindra World City is presently operational at [[Chennai]], [[Tamil Nadu]].

==Business Zone==
The basic idea behind the development of Mahindra World City, Jaipur is to bring forth overall industrial development across different segments of the industry. The business zone is classified into a Domestic Tariff Area (DTA) for several industries and multi-product services with specific zones SEZs which include:
* [[Information Technology in India|IT/ITES]]
* Engineering and Related Industries
* [[Handicrafts]]
* [[Apparel]]
* [[Gemstone|Gems]] and [[Jewellery]]
* Warehousing and Logistics
Some of the prominent companies that are operational within Mahindra World City, Jaipur include [[Genpact]], [[Appirio]], [[Infosys]], [[Wipro]], [[ICICI Bank]], Connexions, [[Deutsche Bank]], GirnarSoft, Nagarro, Aro granite industries ltd., QH Talbros.<ref>{{cite web|title=Mahindra World City, Jaipur marches on Signs-up four new clients|url=http://www.mahindra.com/News/Press-Releases/1293603854|publisher=Mahindra Group|accessdate=9 July 2014|archive-date=14 July 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714164725/http://www.mahindra./|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Infosys to build facility at Jaipur SEZ|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2011-06-17/news/29669842_1_infosys-bpo-facility-development-centres|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130824070851/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2011-06-17/news/29669842_1_infosys-bpo-facility-development-centres|url-status=dead|archive-date=24 August 2013|accessdate=9 July 2014|work=Economic Times|date=17 June 2011}}</ref>

The Isys Softech is currently been inaugurated by Home Minister of Rajasthan [[Gulab Chand Kataria]].

==Social Infrastructure==
The social infrastructure in [https://mahindralifespacesupcoming.com/jaipur/mahindra-world-city-plots/ Mahindra World City Jaipur] is comprehensive in terms of residential, learning, health institutes, and recreational zones. It also includes retail and hospitality centers as integral parts of the development.<ref>{{cite web|title=Mahindra World City, Jaipur marches on Signs-up four new clients|url=http://www.mahindra.com/News/Press-Releases/1293603854|publisher=Mahindra Group|accessdate=9 July 2014|archive-date=14 July 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714164725/http://www.mahindra./|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Architecture==
The layout of Mahindra World City, Jaipur has been conceptualized and planned by Jurong Consultants of [[Singapore]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jurong.com/index.php/portfolio/detail?task=detail&id=115|publisher=Jurong International| archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714182910/http://www.jurong.com/index.php/portfolio/detail?task=detail&id=115 | title=Mahindra World City (Jaipur) | archivedate=14 July 2014 |accessdate=8 June 2018}}</ref> These consultants have been known for using efficient methods and approaches{{By whom|date=May 2025}}, developing Mahindra World City as a destination conducive for international and domestic corporates.
